Consensus: two sessions of 30.016 s on two days stay together at 0.5 and fall into conflict at 0.4921875. Slot: a session joins a quarantine slot at 0.5 and is refused at 0.4921875 (disagree). Update: u . A and u . B both exactly 0.5 are accepted, both 0.4921875 are refused (bound)

steps.note: consensus: the cosine of the two centroids is exactly 0.5
consensus: 0.4921875
an Enrolled record with the unit axis as anchor and a quarantine slot (ear group, dev-b) whose centroid is the same axis
slot: the cosine of the session with the slot's centroid is exactly 0.5
an Enrolled record whose anchor and template are the unit axis
update: u . A and u . B are both exactly 0.5
update: both 0.4921875

cases.name: build_mixed_share_of_the_windows_taken
cases.description: the 30 % rule is taken over the windows that the cap lets in, not over all windows of the call: 100 windows at the hop of 64 chunks, of which 10 of the first 28 (the 28 that fit the cap, 1,856 chunks) are unrelated vectors. 10 are dropped, which is more than 0.30 x 28 = 8.4, so the call is mixed and nothing is recorded (against all 100 windows the 10 would be under the limit of 30 and a session would be recorded)

steps.note: 100 windows; the 72 after the first 28 are not taken

cases.name: build_against_sessions_without_an_anchor
cases.description: a call built from windows against a Learning record that has sessions but no anchor has no consensus to mark a conflict against: its windows need no LLR (l_c is null) and its session carries no conflict mark, whatever an LLR would say. Two sessions of one person on two days at cosine 0.45 (an earpiece, then a car) are a conflict with no anchor; 24 windows of the contact on day 2 are a third session, and the session of the car falls outside the consensus

steps.note: two sessions at cosine 0.45: a conflict, no anchor
24 windows of the contact, no LLR
the same call with an LLR of -1 on every window: still no mark

cases.name: merge_genuine_call_after_a_long_relative_session
cases.description: a call of the contact 1 h after a long session of a relative (26 windows, 55.296 s, which leaves 4.7 s of the cap free) is built whole (24 windows, 51.2 s), does not agree with the relative's session and is a session of its own, inside the consensus; the relative's session stays outside it

steps.note: the relative answers on day 2: 26 windows, 55.296 s
the contact calls back 1 h after the relative's session ended: 24 windows

cases.name: merge_contribution_small_or_none
cases.description: what a merging call adds is its first retained windows that fit the part of the cap that the session leaves free, and no minimum of speech applies to it: after a session of 55.296 s (26 windows, 147 chunks free) the contact's call 1 h later (24 windows, 51.2 s built) adds one window, 4.096 s, which is under the 8.192 s that a session needs, and the call is merged; after a session that fills the cap exactly (60,000 ms) nothing is free and the call adds nothing: speech, centroid and window count stay as they were, the session ends when the call does and is marked merged

steps.note: 24 windows 1 h later: one window fits the 147 free chunks
the session has 1,875 chunks: nothing is free

cases.name: merge_evening_counts_once
cases.description: an evening counts once towards Enrolled: sessions of 15.008 s on day 0 and day 3 and an evening on day 1 of two calls an hour apart (24 windows, 51.2 s, then 3 windows of another voice and 25 of the contact) make 89.408 s in 3 sessions, Provisional for want of speech (as two sessions, 51.2 s and 53.248 s, the same days would make 134.464 s in 4 sessions over 72 h with none above 40 %: Enrolled)

steps.note: the evening, first call: 24 windows, 51.2 s
the evening, second call 1 h later: 3 windows of another voice, then 25 of the contact
day 3

cases.name: merge_interleaved_foreign_call
cases.description: a call of another voice between two calls of the contact in one evening makes the second call of the contact a session of its own, because the previous session is the last entry only: the contact for 40.96 s, a relative for 12.288 s 75 min later and the contact for 40.96 s 75 min after that are three sessions, two of them the contact's (81.92 s in one evening, where a merged session holds at most 60 s); the relative's session stays outside the consensus

steps.note: the contact: 19 windows, 40.96 s
a relative says hello 75 min later: 5 windows, 12.288 s
the contact again 75 min later: 19 windows, 40.96 s

cases.name: merge_added_part_is_not_judged
cases.description: the agreement of a merge is judged on the whole call, and what a merge adds is not judged again: the windows that the build of the call retained are added in time order whatever their voice. After 51.2 s of the contact (275 chunks free) a call 1 h later opens with 8 windows of a second voice (cosine 0.2 with the contact, so that the outlier rejection keeps them: each is 0.45 to 0.48 from the mean of the others, against 0.4) and goes on with 20 windows of the contact. The whole call agrees with the session (0.94) and is merged; the 3 windows that fit the free 8.192 s are all of the second voice, and they would not agree with the session alone (0.20, under tau_sess = 0.5): they are added all the same, and the cosine of the session centroid with the second voice rises from 0.20 to 0.34. A port that judges the agreement on what is added makes a second session of 59.392 s instead

steps.note: 24 windows of the contact: 1,600 chunks, 51.2 s, 275 chunks free
1 h later: 8 windows of a second voice, then 20 of the contact

cases.name: merge_added_part_is_not_filtered_again
cases.description: what a merge adds is taken from the windows that the build of the call retained, with no outlier rejection of its own: a call that holds two voices (10 of its 28 windows are a second voice at cosine 0.3 with the contact, 18 are the contact's) keeps every window in its build, because each voice supports the mean of the other (the windows of the second voice are 0.60 to 0.63 from the mean of the others, against 0.4); after 51.2 s of the contact, the first 3 windows of the call (the second voice, then the contact twice) fit the free 8.192 s and are all added. Filtered again, the first window would be dropped (0.28 from the mean of the other two, under tau_win = 0.4), and the call would add 2 windows and 6.144 s

steps.note: 24 windows of the contact: 51.2 s, 275 chunks free
1 h later: a call with two voices, the second voice first

cases.name: merge_discarded_call_leaves_the_end_time
cases.description: a call that is discarded does not move the end time of the previous session, whatever the reason: after 40.96 s of the contact (18:00 to 18:15), a call of the same voice at 19:30 of 2 windows (6.144 s: short, discarded) leaves the session ending at 18:15; a call at 20:30 is 8,100 s after the session ended, so it is not a merge candidate (3,000 s after the discarded call ended, which would make it one) and is a session of its own: one voice, two sessions in the evening

steps.note: 20:30: 8,100 s after the session ended

cases.name: merge_conflict_mark_without_contribution
cases.description: the conflict mark of the whole call is kept when a merge adds nothing: a session of 59.392 s leaves 19 chunks free, so no window fits; the contact calls again 1 h later with a mean LLR of -1 over 24 windows (against an existing consensus: the mark of the build), the call is merged, adds nothing (no speech, no centroid, no window), the session ends when the call ends and carries the conflict mark

steps.note: 28 windows: 1,856 chunks, 59.392 s, 19 chunks free; Provisional, with an anchor
1 h later: 24 windows with a mean LLR of -1
